title: cosmos bipinnatus var. parviflorus
intro: Cosmos bipinnatus var. parviflorus, commonly known as Dwarf Cosmos, is a variety of the Cosmos bipinnatus plant species. This flowering plant is native to Mexico and is known for its delicate, feathery foliage and vibrant pink or white flowers. The health benefits of Dwarf Cosmos include its antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful for treating anxiety and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Cosmos include flavonoids and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, relaxation, and pain relief.
